poses.name: Player-Discard
poses.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent static player portrait for an existing Unity card battle game. Input image is the exact character identity and art-style reference. Preserve this same adult masculine character: long swept-back white hair, tan skin, golden amber eyes, sharp profile facing right, large gold hoop earring, gold collar, white shoulder scarf and cape with coin ornaments and red/blue gems, bare muscular torso, gold arm cuffs and bracers, dark red trousers and wide black/gold belt. Preserve the angular hand-painted cel-shaded illustration style and warm edge highlights. Portrait aspect 2:3, head to mid thighs, top of hair near 4% from top, belt around 67%, hips anchored at bottom center. Entire head, both arms and hands stay within frame with small transparent margins. Same camera distance and apparent character size as reference. One character only, true transparent background alpha, no halo, no scenery, no floor shadow, no text, no UI, no weapons, no cards, no extra limbs. Create a distinct pose as follows: THOUGHTFUL SELECTION: torso three-quarter right, head tilted slightly down, eyes studying an unseen hand of cards to the right. Right hand near chin with index finger resting lightly along chin, left forearm across lower torso supporting the right elbow. Composed calculating expression. Clear natural hands, calm narrow silhouette.
